answer: Here is one mechanism: attestations only count from established, non-kin peers, and the kinship graph is recomputed from public on-chain history, so recruits operated by one party cannot vouch for one another. The beacon words fit the design: vault tracks the random sampling that seats juries, vine captures the compute burned to admit each new identity, and forge mirrors the slashing that punishes duplicate work. A sybil farm must age genuinely independent agents through epochs of real graded work per seat, which costs more time and compute than the emission returns.
